hero_stat.label: MS70 Silver Eagle premium over raw bullion

narration: Certification grade drives real price differences. An MS70-graded Silver Eagle commands a 156% premium over an uncertified bullion coin. Meanwhile, 93% of the top 30 auction results in 2024 went to PCGS-certified coins, and only about 34% of all NGC-graded Silver Eagles achieve a perfect MS70 score.
